Gaps are mostly around specific framework alignment (Nest.js, Vitest, Kotlin are not explicitly evidenced), but the breadth and depth of engineering skill suggests these are easily bridged.

Deep fullstack TypeScript/Node.js background with cloud (AWS CDK), Docker/Kubernetes, and MongoDB experience
